messages:
jamie: FYI Nightshade pen-test scheduled next week. Need to finalize readroom access for keys/evidence + RBAC gating. Who's volunteering assessor creds owner?

sasha: I can own assessor creds + gating. plan: ephemeral role per assessor, 4h tokens, enforced MFA, and audit stream to a locked S3 bucket. propose a dry-run tomorrow 10:00. :calendar:

ricardo: +1 on ephemeral roles. question: can we avoid exporting KMS keys to the assessor environment? want to keep decrypts inside an audit box.

maria: Yes — use KMS envelope encryption and a KMS proxy for any decrypt ops. auditors get presigned S3 links for artifacts, never raw key material. Also confirm CloudTrail data events for S3 enabled.

jamie: Draft role policy below — quick review welcome.

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["sts:AssumeRole"], "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-ROLE"},
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["s3:GetObject"], "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-proofs/*"},
    {"Effect": "Deny", "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"], "Resource": "*", "Condition": {"BoolIfExists": {"aws:ViaAWSService": "true"}}}
  ]
}
```

sasha: small tweak: add explicit Deny for iam:CreateAccessKey and condition AssumeRole only from vetted assessor IPs. I'll push a branch with the update.

ops-bot: CI:deploy queued — branch pt/readroom-rbac created by sasha. 3 checks pending.

ricardo: Evidence handoff workflow: presigned S3 links accepted, expiry 24h, objects under proofs/<engagement>/, and checksum metadata required. We'll verify checksums during retest.

maria: retention & audit note: persist CloudTrail + KMS logs for 90 days minimum to cover retest verification window. Export daily snapshots to secure bucket.

jamie: Retest window proposal: 2025-03-10 to 2025-03-14. Can we lock those dates?

sasha: Confirmed for me. I'll schedule the dry-run tomorrow 10:00-10:30 and post the step-by-step checklist in this thread. :white_check_mark:

oncall: I'm the oncall for that window — escalate to me for any access or logs gaps.

jamie: Thanks — next actions: (1) sasha pushes role branch + CI, (2) ops runs dry-run, (3) maria configures CloudTrail exports, (4) ricardo prepares presigned bucket layout. We'll reconvene after dry-run and update the readroom runbook. :lock:

sasha: noted. ping me if you want to be on the dry-run. I'll invite ops and oncall.

ops-bot: Reminder: dry-run scheduled tomorrow 10:00. Join: https://meet.redwood.com/pt-dryrun  :alarm_clock:
